object: H042 / EXP-87 four-cost cash-first ownership (25/50/100/150bps TOTAL) on the first533 discovery days
verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED AS AN EXECUTABLE EDGE. The discovery-positive region does not survive selection-aware statistics and measured execution. The evidence remains causally clean and arithmetically exact; it stands as description (the gate concentrates gross continuation; gross per trade rises with the hurdle), not as an extraction candidate.

leak_audit.method: 6-channel code audit + future-perturbation attack (NaN every non-key panel column for t>cutoff, re-run the real feature builder, diff all 164 features) + label/sizing/proceeds/cash0 probes (12 empirical probes).
leak_audit.result: NO LOOK-AHEAD CHANNEL FOUND. 11/11 channels CLEARED. Future-perturbation produced 0 changed cells over 3,900 prefix rows x 164 features (3 cutoffs x 2 days); independent rebuild == published corpus. OOF strict (train/test disjoint, per-fold day assignment exact); sizing never uses fill px (max sizing error 0.0; px/mark p50 1.0000); cash0 identity exact (12,256 books, 0 orders, |ret| = 0).
caveats_not_leaks: UNKNOWN book-dates (3,068/232,864 = 1.32%) are dropped non-randomly: affordability-voided shadow +0.37%/day (dropping conservative), unresolved -0.45%/day (dropping optimistic); net ~+0.15%/day, roughly self-cancelling; headline cell's own 2 dropped days -0.30% and -1.27%.
Headline cell is best-of-576 read on test days; no selection adjustment exists in the artifact.

Provenance gap: the frozen panel names bars_source=ohlcv_<month> but current raw files no longer contain matching bars for at least one sampled claim (AMST 2023-02-14); downstream is internally consistent and sha-pinned at every hop, but raw-independent re-derivation of the panel is not currently possible.

selection_statistics.method: parent, over daily.parquet (known book-dates only, NaN=UNKNOWN); day = cluster; per cost rung the 144 active cells.

family_wise_reality_check.statistic: max over cells of mean/day; null centers each cell and resamples days with replacement (shared draw preserves cross-section); 10,000 draws

tail_power.method: independent agent over daily/per_date/members/fills + the stability artifact (0 discrepancies in 24 best-k cross-checks).
tail_power.power_note: The three ONCE cells (A/B/C) are each 1-3-date phenomena; their bootstrap CIs all include zero; at their observed dispersion 383 dates are short of the ~413/1,328/1,897 independent dates needed to exclude zero. D/E survive remove-best-10 and have month-block CIs excluding zero, but D/E are negative in fold0 (2021-09..2022-04) and derive strength from fold2/2023 (D fold2 +2.94%/day on 81 dates).

execution_recost.method: independent agent; SIP quotes (data/sip/net/quotes, ATLAS top-3 union; window 09:25-16:05; 2024/2025-01 absent) + trades; covered legs re-costed at each leg's measured full quoted spread (monotone, conservative); unquoted legs extrapolated at the cell median.

measured_spread.source: quote-covered legs of the audited cells; px is the SIP tape (|first_print/px-1| median 2.8e-4; 42% exact) and sits ~0.19% from mid

execution_recost.quote_coverage_limit: quotes cover only the ATLAS top-3 union (13-17 symbols/day); 24-48% of legs outside; for cell A 148/511 legs execute before 09:25 and are structurally uncoverable; unquoted legs carry 24-40% of gross notional.
execution_recost.tail_and_instrument_flags: top-5 round trips = 37-81% of net P&L per cell; 86 legs are [A-Z]{1,4}[UW] tickers; 24.3% of legs px<$1; 2-6% of legs inside 09:29-09:31.

symbol_quality.method: independent agent over members/fills/daily + universe files.
symbol_quality.verdict: mild contamination; no warrant/unit exclusion flips any cell sign (all structural deltas <= 0.06pp/day).

defect_found.case: AMV 2022-09-28 clock540 n3: prev_close_adj=52.01 (a 19:12 UTC intraday print) vs true prior-session close 82.12 -> bogus +438% gain ranked #1; worst single member in cell D (net +0.115011 on 25bps; +0.065768 on 50bps; -0.019071 on 100bps).
defect_found.mechanism: AMV absent from the prior-day universe file -> ratio_pc NaN -> flag_prevclose_discrepancy silently False (basket_tape_atlas_observation.py:~3654 requires ~isnan(ratio_pc)).
defect_found.prevalence: 309/997 distinct traded claims in the audited cells are absent from the prior-day universe file (same silent-NaN class); ~15 more with gain_adj>1.93 flagged UNKNOWN (MARK, WBX, ABVC, BSFC, IDAI, TXMD, BCAN, FNHC, XPON, HZN, LHDX, PEPLW, INBS, BLPH, ICCM).
defect_found.reach: cell D mean/day impact of the AMV date ~-0.00022 in daily terms, but it is a genuine substrate defect: any roster study should require a verified non-NaN prev_close.

simple_form.method: independent agent over importances, scores, fills/members, decision grids.
simple_form.importances: horizon-averaged LightGBM gain mass stable core: pm_range_asof ~9-10%, race_n_known ~9%, pm_cum_vol ~6-7%, scan3_mean_ret ~6-7%, pm_n_bars ~5-6%, recovery_from_low ~3.5-5.5%, race_gain ~5.3%, event_count_new_high ~5.2%, event_count_push ~5.0%, peak_gain ~3-4%. Fold-to-fold #1 churns; no per-horizon importances exist.
simple_form.entry_portrait: A (540/n3/h3 once) buys vertical continuation: median ret5 +10.3%, dd_from_high -1.2%, 37% of entries within 30min of 09:00; 195/383 days active, 1-3 entries. B (569/n5/h60 once) buys stalled/faded names: median dd_from_high -5.9%, median 54min after clock, spread to 14:58; 188/383 days active.
simple_form.winner_vs_loser: NO SEPARATION VISIBLE: every coordinate's winner/loser IQRs overlap; best rank statistic P(win>loss) 0.63-0.65 vs SE 0.05, signs flip across cells. The gating forecast does not order outcomes within the admitted band (P 0.421 A / 0.521 B).
simple_form.view_effects: sel_h argmax equals the gated view only 43% (A) / 57% (B); pred_max carries a 48-68% optimism premium and the max view takes 2-3x more entries and loses (clock540 n3 100bps max once -0.00069/day; clock569 n5 100bps max once -0.00227/day).
